name: a tag between backticks a renderer never pairs
why: A renderer closes a run of N backticks only with the next run of exactly N, so the run of three here opens nothing and the tag is a live element on the page. A reader that pairs each backtick with the next one reads two spans, finds nothing outside them, and the backtick count is even, so neither rule fires.
fails: quotes code in a form this snapshot does not read

rows.headline: protection worked by surprise
